mass.name: Monday of the Second Week of Lent

preface.locus: Missale Romanum 1962, registered CMAA facsimile; printed p. 81; PDF physical p. 162; unnumbered Praefatio de Quadragesima appointment following Secreta; preface body is referred to, not printed within this formulary; expected-target row roman-1962:temporal:slot:feria-2-post-dominicam-2-in-quadragesima:preface

ordinary_frame.basis: The source appoints an Oratio super populum after the Postcommunion (printed p. 82, artifact PDF p. 163, numbered unit 551). This remains a Mass. The held generic Ordinary has no declared seat for this prayer, and its Ordo Missae inventory explicitly leaves the Lenten ferial prayer unplaced. The Proper rows retain the Missal's order while the generic frame is withheld.

provenance.provenance_evidence: The project-owned projection passage reproduces the retained calendar body hash exactly. Its artifact manifest records the bounded public-domain 1862 Pustet antecedent, the separate 1962 target, and every editorial transformation; neither witness is represented as owning the projected bytes. The 1962 reading was established on that edition's page images rather than its text layer, cross-read against the Benziger conformed printing. Differences from the antecedent: 1862 conclusion is the shorter cue without nostrum; 1862 text layer damages 3 place(s) in this prayer; at each the 1962 word and the layer's reading are: presta quesumus omnipotens -> prsesta qusesumus ommpo tens; que -> qua; sectando -> sect ndo; 1922 Mame text layer damages 2 place(s) here (chiefly its OCR of the ae/oe ligatures and of the acute accents): presta quesumus -> rasta queeesumuus; affligendo -> affligen feria i post dominicam i quadragesime do; both antecedents print the ae and oe ligatures and the printed acute accents, and use the j-orthography; this transcription follows the repository convention recorded in src/sources/calendars/roman-1962/propers.yaml (j retained, ae/oe digraphs written as two letters, no accent marks). Corroboration: 1922 Mame, editio quarta iuxta typicam Vaticanam (public domain), printed p. 100, artifact PDF p. 214; Benziger 1962 conformed printing OCR at djvu text line 28922 (comparison witness only, rights_status unresolved; never a publication basis); the 1604 and 1570 were not consulted for this oration - the 1862 and the 1922 Mame between them read the whole prayer.

propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Praesta, quaesumus, omnipotens Deus: ut familia tua, quae se, affligendo
carnem, ab alimentis abstinet; sectando justitiam, a culpa jejunet. Per
Dominum nostrum.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:

esse consortes. Per Dominum.
